name: Kaiserhotel
beschreibung: The Kaiserhotel in Ebbs is picturesquely situated at the base of the dramatic Kaisergebirge range in the lower Inn Valley. Managed with personal warmth, this family-run hotel provides authentic Tyrolean hospitality. Comfortable guest rooms feature private balconies overlooking the rugged limestone peaks of the Zahmer and Wilder Kaiser. Guests can unwind in the wellness area with an indoor pool, various saunas, and tranquil relaxation lounges. The restaurant serves multi-course dinners highlighting fresh regional farm products. In summer, excursions into the pristine Kaisertal and visits to the famous Fohlenhof Ebbs stud farm await, while top winter ski areas are close at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Welcoming family hotel in Ebbs at the foot of the Kaisergebirge featuring an indoor pool, saunas, and local dining.
